cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Not Dismissed
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by treating departure as a privilege only you can grant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The shop is shut, but you leave when I release you. A counted till is not a completed close.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've counted it twice. My daughter's waiting outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Counting checks the cash; reconciliation checks the record. Bring her in while I finish, please. Nobody is dismissed halfway through a process.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's in our taxi now. The driver wants to go.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put him on speaker. Departure time comes from the person closing the shop, not the person starting an engine. I'll tell him when you're released.

reason: Use exacting till procedure to claim sole dismissal authority, with B waiting transport causing A to extend that release channel directly to the driver.
